full_text:
Aqua Jet  (Japanese: アクアジェット Aqua Jet) is a damage-dealing Water-type move introduced in Generation IV.


== Effect ==
Aqua Jet inflicts damage. It has a priority of +1, so is used before all moves that do not have increased priority.


=== Generation VIII ===


==== Pokémon Legends: Arceus ====
Aqua Jet raises the user's action speed.


=== Generation IX ===


==== Pokémon Legends: Z-A ====
Like all other moves that previously possessed priority, Aqua Jet causes the user to dash forward to make damaging contact with the target (although terrain may interfere with doing so). During the dash, the user is intangible and will not make contact with projectiles and hazards that they pass through.
